description: Finds passages across the library (or in one book) whose English translation or original text contains the query. Returns up to 10 matches as references with one line of English and links; call get_passage to read a match word by word. Greek can be typed with or without accents.

book.description: Optional book title or slug to search within.

query.description: Words to find, e.g. "unexamined life", "the Word", "Circe", "λόγος".

name: search
title: Search the library
